Ajel News 67 days ago · 1 min read X f Key Takeaways AI Asharq Bloomberg has reported that the Sudanese army is targeting Rapid Support Forces (RSF) positions in North and West Kordofan. Mohammed Hamdan Dagalo, known as Hemeti and leader of the so-called Rapid Support Forces, announced that his commanders would be on the front lines and that he would join them in the field, following RSF losses along the Omdurman–Al-Ubayyid road. The Sudanese army also announced it had seized RSF weapons depots after battles in Kordofan. Meanwhile, key regional actors are supporting efforts to strengthen the Sudanese state and prevent the presence of any unlawful groups.
